name: youtube-music
tagline: A lightweight, ad-free YouTube Music client built on a reverse-engineered API
description: youtube-music is a lightweight YouTube Music client that skips ads and any subscription requirement. It offers background playback, search, and custom playlists, all powered by a reverse-engineered API rather than a paid tier. At 850+ stars with zero forks, it is a brand-new, under-the-radar project that has yet to spawn copycats.
highlights: Ad-free listening with no subscription required
Background playback plus search and custom playlists
Built on a reverse-engineered YouTube Music API
850+ stars with zero forks — a fresh, uncopied project
Lightweight client for daily music streaming
curatorNote: A brand-new client with 850+ stars and literally zero forks — so new it hasn't been copied yet. The reverse-engineered API approach makes ad-free YouTube Music practical without a subscription, which is exactly why it took off so fast.
